<section class="testimonial"><figure class="quote"><blockquote>Positronic lets us evaluate checkpoints continuously as we train, so we can course-correct our research quickly. Day-to-day evaluation doesn’t compete with our robot fleet or operators for time, which keeps them focused on data collection and real-world deployment.</blockquote><figcaption>Andy Chen, Head of Robotics, Runway</figcaption></figure></section>

<section class="band"><div class="rail"><span class="label">How it works</span></div><div class="col"><ol class="howto"><li><span class="step-verb">1. Sign up</span><p>Create an account in the <a href="{APP_URL}/signin">console</a> and add funds.</p></li><li><span class="step-verb">2. Connect your model</span><p>A container image, or an endpoint you serve.</p></li><li><span class="step-verb">3. Choose where it runs</span><p>Real robots or simulators, and the tasks.</p></li><li><span class="step-verb">4. Get the results</span><p>We run the episodes. You get a video, the robot data and a score for each one.</p></li></ol><p class="more"><a href="/docs">Read the docs</a></p></div></section>
